_readme: One entry per robot. `spike discover` prints every hub it can see with the values to paste here.
ble_address: the hub's Bluetooth address - how `--hub NAME` picks this robot even when both are switched on.
usb_serial:  the hub's USB serial number - used by `spike usb ... --hub NAME`.
Without --hub, Bluetooth connects to whichever hub is advertising and USB uses the one hub plugged in.

robot1.notes: Ports: A/E Large Motors (drive base), C/D Medium Motors, B/F Color Sensors. Hub OS 1.8.149.

robot2.notes: NOT YET REGISTERED. Switch on only this robot (Bluetooth light blinking), run `spike discover`, paste its address here; plug it into USB and repeat for the serial.
